text:
jordan: Quick heads up: Realtime streaming + function/tool-calling is GA for the Conduit family.
- New endpoints: POST /v1/realtime/connect (websocket) and POST /v1/realtime/stream (http streaming).
- Models: conduit-base, conduit-pro (low-latency), conduit-long (optimized for >64k contexts).
- Feature parity with dev preview: function calling, structured JSON outputs, and chunked transcript events.

priya: Rollout plan: canary in eu-central-1 now, us-east and us-west within 6h, global after 24h verification. Customers on the beta channel are auto-migrated; others need to opt in.

release-bot: Canary started: conduit-pro on eu-central-1 (rg-realtime-02). Logs: https://infra.logs/redwood/realtime/canary/1780123456

jordan: Note for teams: old streaming endpoint /v1/stream (legacy) will be deprecated in 90 days. We'll publish a migration guide and a compatibility shim in the SDKs. Please avoid building new integrations against /v1/stream.

sre-oncall: SRE notes: default concurrent websocket connections per account = 50. Idle connection timeout = 10m. Long-running sessions may be interrupted during failover; design clients to reconnect and resume using session_id.

docbot: Docs + examples pushed: internal doc link https://go.redwood.ai/docs/realtime-conduit. Included: sample websocket client, server-side webhook per-message acknowledgements, and Rust/Go/Node examples.

priya: Billing: realtime streams are billed per-second of active compute + tokens emitted. No change to sync endpoint pricing. We added a short FAQ about cost controls in the docs.

jordan: SDKs: node v1.12 / python 0.40 will include RealtimeClient with reconnection helpers. Patch releases landing in ~1h.

sre-oncall: Ops reminder: enable backpressure handling, respect stream.flow_control messages. Also be mindful of payload size on function-call args — large binary blobs should be stored externally.

priya: Migration checklist in the docs includes: update endpoint, switch to RealtimeClient helpers, test function schema validation, and update monitoring alerts for new metric names (realtime.latency, realtime.sessions).

jordan: Huge thanks to infra/serving/sdks/docs for the push. If you see any regressions during the ramp, ping #eng-oncall and @sre-oncall. :tada:
